title: An invoiced split work order shows both names as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-B}; it has just been invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative rows.
  2. Click "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B} show as plain text, with no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.
  • Step 2: nothing opens; the representatives cannot be changed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R17, S1-N1, S2-E4, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 1 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names.”
  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”
